purpose: Reproduce a metadata-only exact-TIC overlap preflight for a publication-backed ASAS-SN variability benchmark candidate without accepting automated catalog classes as ground truth

catalog.name: ASAS-SN Catalog X
catalog.classification_basis: ASAS-SN g-band light curves classified by an updated random-forest pipeline augmented with Citizen ASAS-SN data and publication quality control; catalog probabilities and the known/new flag must be preserved.
catalog.label_quality_limit: The Class field is machine-learning output, not human ground truth. A gate pass authorizes only follow-up benchmark design and never supervised training, promotion, or a production scoring change.

exploratory_observation.purpose: Bound the value of implementing a reproducible gate; this is explicitly exploratory and is not the durable evidence run.

evidence_gate.threshold_basis: Reproducibility floor set transparently after the exploratory preflight at half its observed exact-match and known-variable counts; it detects material source drift without presenting the exploratory result as blinded evidence.

limitations: The preflight issues exact-ID TAP metadata queries only; it does not download the 64258159-byte table or any ASAS-SN light curve.
The ASAS-SN Class field is automated classifier output. Preserve Class, Prob, Discovery, and source identity; do not call these rows ground truth.
A pass does not authorize FITS reads, embedding extraction, model training, model promotion, or production scoring changes.
All six shard outputs must reconcile globally before the source can advance to a separately reviewed benchmark-design gate.
